statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc (x/2) x; let primes := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 3 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p); let wheel := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ primes z, p; let rough := fun x z : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun k => Nat.Coprime (f k) (wheel z)); ∀ x lo hi : ℕ, 0<x → lo≤hi →
  (rough x lo).card =
    (rough x hi).card + ((block x).filter (fun k => lo < (f k).minFac ∧ (f k).minFac ≤ hi)).card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0079 · 按真实最小素因子记账两个筛口之间的流失
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0079 · Account for the losses between two cutoffs using the actual least prime factor

brief.zh: 对 k>0，4k²+1 是大于一的奇数。逐点使用最小素因子所在的唯一带，包含右边界。此分割可在同一 x 上迭代。
brief.en: For k>0 the value 4k²+1 is odd and greater than one. Assign each point to the unique band of its least factor and include the right endpoint. Iterate the partition at the same x.
